```{r}
#load libraries
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
#pull in full Ap hz data:
Ap_hz_perry <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/Ap_hz_data/perry_Ap_data_full_02_10_2026.csv")

#depth weighting function
# -----------------------------
# 1) Clean depths
# -----------------------------
Ap_hz_clean <- Ap_hz_perry %>%
  mutate(
    top_cm    = as.numeric(str_extract(To.Depth..cm., "^\\d+")),
    bottom_cm = as.numeric(str_extract(To.Depth..cm., "(?<=-)\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bottom_cm = ifelse(
      is.na(bottom_cm) & !is.na(top_cm) & !is.na(H.Depth.cm.),
      top_cm + H.Depth.cm.,
      bottom_cm
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(top_cm),
    is.finite(bottom_cm),
    bottom_cm > top_cm
  )

# -----------------------------
# 2) Depth-weighting function (0–15 cm)
# -----------------------------
depth_weighted_0_15 <- function(df, value_col,
                               id_col = "Point",
                               top_col = "top_cm",
                               bot_col = "bottom_cm",
                               zmax = 15) {

  df %>%
    mutate(
      z_top = .data[[top_col]],
      z_bot = .data[[bot_col]],
      val   = as.numeric(.data[[value_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(val)) %>%
    mutate(
      thick = pmax(0, pmin(z_bot, zmax) - pmax(z_top, 0))
    ) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      cover_cm = sum(thick, na.rm = TRUE),
      value_0_15 = ifelse(
        cover_cm >= zmax,
        sum(val * thick, na.rm = TRUE) / zmax,
        NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# 3) Choose nutrient columns to depth-weight
#    (edit this vector if you want)
# -----------------------------
nutrients <- c("Ca","K","Mg","Mn","P","Zn","pH.2","LBC.1","LBCeq","C_pct","N_pct")

# keep only nutrients that actually exist in your dataframe
nutrients <- nutrients[nutrients %in% names(Ap_hz_clean)]
print(nutrients)

# -----------------------------
# 4) Compute all depth-weighted 0–15 results
# -----------------------------
hz_0_15_list <- map(nutrients, ~{
  out <- depth_weighted_0_15(Ap_hz_clean, value_col = .x)
  names(out)[names(out) == "value_0_15"] <- paste0(.x, "_0_15")
  out
})
names(hz_0_15_list) <- nutrients

# -----------------------------
# 5) Combine into ONE WIDE dataset (1 row per Point)
# -----------------------------
hz_0_15_wide <- reduce(hz_0_15_list, full_join, by = "Point")

# quick checks
cat("\nRows (Points):", nrow(hz_0_15_wide), "\n")
na_summary <- hz_0_15_wide %>%
  summarise(across(-Point, ~sum(is.na(.x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "var", values_to = "n_NA") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_NA))
print(na_summary)

# -----------------------------
# 6) ALSO make a LONG dataset (good for distributions/plots)
# -----------------------------
hz_0_15_long <- hz_0_15_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Point,
    names_to = "nutrient",
    values_to = "value_0_15"
  )

# Example: distribution summaries by nutrient
dist_summary <- hz_0_15_long %>%
  group_by(nutrient) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(is.finite(value_0_15)),
    min = min(value_0_15, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(value_0_15, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value_0_15, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(value_0_15, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(value_0_15, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value_0_15, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(dist_summary)

# -----------------------------
# 7) Optional: save
# -----------------------------
hz_0_15_wide <- hz_0_15_wide %>%
#remove  columns with .x or .y
  dplyr::select(Point, ends_with("_0_15")) %>%
  #remove na rows
  filter(if_any(-Point, ~is.finite(.x))) %>%
  #add point locs
  left_join(
    Ap_hz_clean %>%
      dplyr::select(Point, POINT_X, POINT_Y) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "Point"
  ) 



write.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/Ap_hz_data/perry_Ap_hz_0_15cm_depth_func_02_10_2026.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
